name: server
description: ClipPro API and workers (FastAPI + Celery). Python is managed by uv; these scripts wrap it.

scripts.setup: uv sync && pnpm run infra:up && pnpm run migrate
scripts.dev: pnpm run infra:up && concurrently -k -n api,worker,beat -c blue,magenta,gray "pnpm:dev:api" "pnpm:dev:worker" "pnpm:dev:beat"
scripts.dev:worker: uv run celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker -Q gpu,cpu,default -P threads -c 2 -l INFO
scripts.dev:beat: uv run celery -A app.workers.celery_app beat -l INFO
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait redis s3 && docker compose up s3-init
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
